scope_note: This defines the early psychology school only; it does not describe later structuralism in linguistics, anthropology, literary studies or psychoanalysis.
statement: Psychological structuralism defined psychology as the study of mental experience and investigated the structure of that experience.
statement_zh: 心理學中的結構主義把心理學界定為對心理經驗的研究，並探究這類經驗的結構。
